notes: Shopify storefront (robots.txt fully Allow: / for user-agent *, no Claude-specific disallow; used HTTP-tier access throughout - curl for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, sitemap_collections_1.xml, and per-collection /products.json + collection HTML - no Playwright/Chrome needed). Pulled the full collections sitemap (~103 collection URLs, single sitemap_collections_1.xml, confirmed complete) and cross-checked against the homepage nav. Total catalog size established by paging /collections/all-products/products.json (6x250 + 147 = 1647 products), used as denominator for the inflated-holiday-collection sanity check. Seasonal-looking candidates found: diwali, christmas, christmas-gifting, festive-gifting, reindeer, gift-hampers, gift-hamper. Each was content-verified by sampling its actual /products.json product list (not just title/URL), per instructions. INCLUDED: (1) 'diwali' (17/1647=1.0% of catalog) - og:title/H1 both 'Diwali', products are diyas (stone diyas explicitly named 'Diya'), oil lamps/torches, lanterns, candle holders - genuinely Diwali-appropriate lighting/decor, the classic 'festival of lights' merchandise mix. (2) 'christmas' (23/1647=1.4%) - og:title/H1 both 'Christmas', products are a Christmas tree, Santa/tree-shaped candles, and tree/angel/snowman/soldier/bell ornaments - unambiguously Christmas-specific. EXCLUDED after content sampling (the exact trap flagged in task instructions): 'christmas-gifting' (63/1647=3.8%) - despite the URL slug, its own page H1 reads plain 'Gifting' (not Christmas), and its 63 products are generic home-decor/tableware (drinkware, vases, cushion covers, cutlery, zodiac key-holder frames, dinner plates) with zero Christmas-themed items - a generic gift catalog under a holiday-sounding slug, not genuine Christmas content. 'festive-gifting' (129/1647=7.8%) - H1 'Festive Gifting' but all 129 products are generic chandeliers/pendant lamps/candle holders/soy candles/table lamps with no tie to any specific festival - a generic 'gifting season' lighting/candle catalog, not evidence of any one holiday. 'reindeer' - a genuine Christmas-themed taxonomy node (og:description 'holiday decor, ornaments, and gifts perfect for the festive season', breadcrumb present, real collection ID) but /products.json returns 0 products - currently empty, nothing to enumerate, so no row written. 'gift-hampers' and 'gift-hamper' - both 0 products (empty/deprecated collections), and neither is holiday-specific by name anyway. Checked specifically and thoroughly for Diwali given this is an Indian retailer: found and validated the dedicated 'diwali' collection (see above); no separate Diwali sub-collections (e.g. diwali-diyas, diwali-lights) exist elsewhere in the sitemap. Also specifically searched the full collection list and homepage nav for New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, Valentine's Day, Easter, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Mother's Day and Father's Day - none exist as collections anywhere in the site's sitemap or nav (homepage currently shows no active seasonal banners either, consistent with early September being off-season for Diwali/Christmas). No suspicious auto-generated/search-alias URL patterns were seen (this is a small, hand-curated ~103-collection Shopify catalog, not a marketplace), so the nonsense-slug test was not required.
